answer: The nectar schedule is applied in timber and ember exposes each instalment. A payout is split which means 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 4 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2564 identities would post 2435 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
